name: Capture sources and weave visual drafts
description: Verifies the primary workflow captures visible source inputs first and then creates visual drafts from the frozen capture.
steps: Enter "wind 8 m/s, wet pavement, midnight train" in Source material
expected: A frozen capture fingerprint is shown and twelve visual draft cards appear while the Intent bias field remains optional.

name: Replay one frozen capture
description: Verifies weaving the same frozen capture with unchanged controls does not silently recapture live signals.
steps: Press "Capture + weave" once and note draft #01 fingerprint
Do not change the seed, chaos, intent, or source fields
expected: The frozen capture fingerprint remains unchanged and draft #01 keeps the same result fingerprint.

name: Reject malformed external packet
description: Verifies malformed connector or working-chat packets are rejected visibly instead of being silently interpreted.
steps: Enter "{bad json" in External signal packet · JSON
expected: A visible message says the external packet is not valid JSON and no new frozen capture is created.

name: Inspect source provenance on mobile
description: Verifies the result packet exposes the source capture rather than pretending the optional intent text was the source.
steps: Scroll to the Captured Result inspector
expected: The packet visibly contains capture.local, sourceMaterial, externalPacket, capture fingerprint, intentBias, seed, chaos, result fingerprint, and field data.
